## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
CAUTION — low volatility but extremely narrow participation: Vol: 24.6%. Breadth: 1/8 sectors positive.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Banking & Finance is the only positive sector and the clear leader; GARAN (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +2.42% | 1M: +7.20%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +13.01%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Construction & REIT, Technology & Telecom and Heavy Industry are the weakest; TKFEN (1W: -16.52% | 1M: -9.12%) BELOW TREND, KONTR (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -40.63%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -9.53%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
GARAN (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOKM (1W: +3.94% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +2.42% | 1M: +7.20%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +13.01%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -10.88%) BELOW TREND, ENKAI (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -5.06%) BELOW TREND, SASA (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -28.97%) BELOW TREND, FROTO (1W: -4.91% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND, ARCLK (1W: -4.91% | 1M: -11.86%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest moves include TKFEN (1W: -16.52% | 1M: -9.12%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -9.53%) BELOW TREND, KONTR (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -40.63%) BELOW TREND, GARAN (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOKM (1W: +3.94% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Cautious positive for banks; GARAN (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +2.42% | 1M: +7.20%) ABOVE TREND, AKBNK (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +4.29%) CORRECTION, VAKBN (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +10.43%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed to negative across heavy industry: EREGL (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY, FROTO (1W: -4.91% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -9.53%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Downside pressure persists; TUPRS (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND, SASA (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -28.97%) BELOW TREND, TRALT (1W: +1.47% | 1M: -8.42%) RECOVERY, SISE (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -2.51%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Defensive posture: trim high-beta and broken names, overweight high-quality bank exposures and selective above‑trend names (GARAN, ISCTR, YKBNK), keep cash dry for pullback trades in beaten-up cyclicals.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
GARAN (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND for continuation, TKFEN (1W: -16.52% | 1M: -9.12%) BELOW TREND for volatility/trade setups, SASA (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -28.97%) BELOW TREND as downside may extend, SOKM (1W: +3.94% | 1M: +3.11%) ABOVE TREND for retail resilience.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Banking & Finance for leadership and earnings/flow clarity, Construction & REIT for continued weakness and downside risk, Technology & Telecom for potential continuation of sector weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Market is rangebound with low vol — watch XU100 intraday breaks and volume: a decisive breach of weekly support would validate risk-off moves; macro triggers are CPI prints, CBRT commentary, FX swings and major BIST50 earnings headlines.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Cautionary regime: low volatility but very narrow leadership with only banking staying positive. Short-term opportunity in above‑trend banks (GARAN, ISCTR, YKBNK) while avoiding broken high-beta names (TKFEN, KONTR, TOASO); monitor macro catalysts and volume for a regime shift.
